page: Amazon Web Services m8gd.8xlarge is a general-purpose cloud instance built on the Nitro hypervisor and powered by custom AWS ARMv9 Neoverse-V2 processors. The configuration features 32 dedicated physical arm64 cores running at 2.8 GHz without simultaneous multithreading, providing 32 dedicated vCPUs. Memory is allocated at a 1:4 compute-to-RAM ratio with 128 GB of system memory (4.0 GB per vCPU). In addition to its 15 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, the instance integrates 1,900 GB of high-speed local NVMe SSD storage.

Benchmark data reflects strong memory and multi-core efficiency alongside high I/O throughput. The instance ranks in the top tier (top 10%) for large-block uncached memory read bandwidth (363.94 GB/sec), large-block write bandwidth (182.89 GB/sec), and PassMark memory operations. Multi-core performance is similarly elevated, reaching the top 10% in Geekbench multi-core (21,404.0) and top 25% in multi-threaded software compilation. In database-oriented tests, the system achieved top-tier marks in PassMark database operations (47,242.75) and strong throughput in Redis SET operations (67.21 million ops/sec) and static web serving (73.58 GB/sec).

Single-core performance and large language model inference fall within average brackets, demonstrating that this architecture delivers its value through horizontal scaling and memory throughput rather than extreme single-thread burst speed or GPU acceleration. With 1,900 GB of direct-attached NVMe storage bundled into the node, the instance delivers high data transfer density and qualitative cost efficiency for I/O-sensitive workloads. Typical deployment targets include relational and NoSQL database hosting, high-throughput caching tiers, microservices, continuous integration build clusters, and high-concurrency web serving.
description: Amazon Web Services m8gd.8xlarge is an ARM-based general-purpose instance featuring 32 dedicated cores powered by AWS ARMv9 Neoverse-V2 processors running at 2.8 GHz on the Nitro hypervisor. It is configured with 128 GB of RAM, a 15 Gbps baseline network interface, and 1,900 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. In benchmark evaluations, the m8gd.8xlarge registers top-tier results in uncached memory read and write bandwidth, Geekbench multi-core compute, and PassMark database operations, while achieving strong marks for multi-threaded Clang compilation, Redis operations, and static web serving throughput. Single-core performance and raw LLM inference remain average, prioritizing aggregate multi-core and memory efficiency over single-thread peak speed. The integrated NVMe instance store eliminates network storage latency, making the instance well suited for transactional databases, caching layers, software build farms, and high-traffic web applications.
